en.headline: Sun says Sandy Ridge computing power to reach 36 times today's level
en.dek: The innovation secretary told legislators the first five-year plan treats artificial intelligence as a core industry, with a Sandy Ridge data campus due by 2032.
body: Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong told the Legislative Council on Tuesday that Hong Kong's first five-year plan treats artificial intelligence as an important industry, and that the government would push an "AI+" drive covering computing power and wider use by small and medium-sized firms.

On computing capacity, Sun said construction of the Sandy Ridge data campus had started. He said the computing power it is expected to provide by 2032 would be equivalent to 36 times Hong Kong's present capacity, with cumulative investment of at least HK$23.8 billion. He said that would support smart computing and the AI industry.

For smaller firms, he said the government would refine the Digital Transformation Support Pilot Programme and use matching grants so more companies could adopt AI and cybersecurity tools. He also said a citywide AI literacy programme was under way, with a target of more than 200 courses and related activities by the first quarter of 2028. The television series AI Lecture Hall, an early part of that programme, had drawn more than 1.8 million views, he said.

Sun also briefed members on changes to the 1823 hotline set out in the Policy Address. He said a department that receives a case after it is referred on must follow it through, so callers are not left without a coordinator.

zh.headline: 孫東：沙嶺數據園區2032年前算力料達現時36倍
zh.dek: 創新科技及工業局局長孫東向立法會簡介五年規劃，指人工智能是重點產業，沙嶺數據園區已動工，累計投資最少238億元。
body: 創新科技及工業局局長孫東周二在立法會簡報五年規劃及施政報告時表示，香港首份五年規劃把人工智能列為未來發展的重要產業，當局會全面推進「AI+」行動，提升算力基建，並加快中小企應用人工智能。
算力方面，孫東說沙嶺數據園區已經動工，預計2032年或之前提供的算力相當於目前香港算力的36倍，累計投資規模最少238億元，為智能計算及人工智能產業提供支撐。
支援中小企方面，他說政府會優化數碼轉型支援先導計劃，以配對資助協助更多企業採用人工智能及網絡安全方案。全民人工智能普惠計劃已經展開，目標在2028年第一季或之前推出超過200個課程及相關活動。打頭陣的電視節目《AI大講堂》至今已有超過180萬人次收看。他又說，各單位正制訂詳細方案，並會在統一平台匯集相關資訊。
孫東亦談及施政報告提出優化1823熱線。他說制度上已作調整，以提高轉接效率和準確性；前線部門把問題轉交有關部門後，該部門要一跟到底，以免出現無人協調的情況。
